criteria_results.text: A stalled Gallery catalog request through the paired Cloud Gateway exits the shared paired-tool loading state within the existing 12-second service deadline and shows a retryable error instead of leaving the screen on an infinite spinner.
criteria_results.notes: The first combined signed Release build left both rhythmagents://tools/gallery and rhythmagents://tools/profiles on Loading for more than 14 seconds. A follow-up preserved the mounted refresh callback across service identity changes and expanded the c20 contract to exercise repeated service replacement plus Profiles; that suite passed 2/2. After rebuilding and reinstalling the signed Release, Gallery still remained on Loading for an additional period longer than 14 seconds, with a quiet console. Service identity churn was therefore one real refresh-reset trigger, but not the sole trigger. The revised contract still mounts RhythmToolsProvider directly and holds the surrounding account, paired-host, activeProjectPath, availability, and cache-scope lifecycle outside the test; the physical app runs through AppRhythmToolsProvider, where those hydration and probe transitions can still restart or invalidate the visible request deadline.

failure_output: Second physical iPhone Release after the serviceRef follow-up: Gallery still remained on Loading for more than 14 additional seconds. The revised service-replacement and Profiles deadline contract passed 2/2 before rebuild/reinstall, and the device console remained quiet.
suggested_follow_up: Replace the direct RhythmToolsProvider c20 proxy with a full AppRhythmToolsProvider contract that drives account, paired-host probe, activeProjectPath, availability, and cache-scope hydration transitions during one stalled request and proves one monotonic 12-second deadline survives them.
